description: After a deluge of dance producers sampling QSO's classic 'Pushin On' the original composer Will Holland decided the time had come to take the wheel himself. 'I Won't Fade Away' features the timeless vocal of Alice Russell but veers away from previous channels, deep diving into UKG through an analogue lens, tape hiss included. By mining the less obvious vocal aspects and taking unexpected steps through broken beats, Quantic has cooked up a genuine dance floor anthem just in time for our return.
credits:
Contains a sample of The Quantic Soul Orchestra "Pushin On" feat Alice Russell
Written, Produced & Mixed by William Holland
Published by Full Thought Publishing
